description: Record a fill, close or cancellation. Submit filled_notional_usd as the per-fill increment. Every PARTIAL requires fill_seq (1..10,000, up to 64 partial sequences per lease). Leased terminal FILLED, CLOSED, or CANCELLED may omit fill_seq or use a fresh sequence, even after 64 partials. An identical PARTIAL retry with the same fill_seq returns 409 lease_already_reconciled at zero charge. Changed parameters on a retained sequence return 400 invalid_arguments. Leased calls reject report_id and report_seq with 400 invalid_arguments. Retrying a terminal or exhausted lease returns 409 lease_already_reconciled while its receipt exists (24 hours, 512 tombstones), then 400 invalid_arguments after expiry or eviction. Unleased CLOSED (positive or flat-book amount-zero) and unleased CANCELLED require report_id and a strictly increasing workspace report_seq. Read metrics.report_seq in get_workspace_state for the last accepted sequence. Retry with the original ID and sequence. Retry matching treats bbb and BBB alike, and 100.0 and 100 alike. Identical retries return 409 lease_already_reconciled at zero charge within the separate 24-hour, 512-report receipt map. After eviction or expiry the report_seq high-water mark returns 400 invalid_arguments.
name: reconcile_trade
